segments.text: The theory of relativity, developed by Albert Einstein, fundamentally changed our understanding of space and time. According to this theory, the fabric of spac
is intertwined with the presence of mass. This means that massive objects like planets and stars can warp the spac
around them. Consequently, time can pass at different rates depending on the gravitational field one is in. For example, a clock on Earth will tick slightly s
than a clock in orbit. This phenomenon has been confirmed through various experiments, demonstrating the profound implications of relativity on our comprehens
of the universe. As scientists continue to explore the universe, these principles remain critical in the study of astrophysics and cosmology.

academic.passage: The theory of relativity, proposed by Albert Einstein, revolutionized physics by introducing concepts that challenged traditional notions of space and time. It posits that time and space are not absolute; rather, they are relative and affected by mass and speed. This insight has led to numerous advancements in physics, including understanding gravity's role in shaping the universe. The implications of relativity extend beyond theoretical physics, influencing technologies such as GPS, which must account for relativistic effects to ensure accuracy.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: The theory of relativity has practical applications in technology.
Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity.
Time and space are not absolute according to relativity.
Relativity has influenced advancements in astrophysics.
questions.explain: 這段文字的主題是相對論中的時間和空間不是絕對的，這是相對論的重要觀點。

questions.q: What practical application of relativity is mentioned in the passage?
options: Understanding black holes.
Improving telecommunications.
GPS technology.
Astronomical observations.
questions.explain: 文中提到 GPS 技術必須考慮到相對論效應，以確保準確性。

questions.q: What can be inferred about the impact of relativity on technology?
options: It is irrelevant to modern technology.
It enhances the precision of navigation systems.
It complicates the design of satellites.
It has no effect on our daily lives.
questions.explain: 相對論的原則對導航系統的精確性至關重要，這表明它對技術有重要影響。

questions.q: What does the term 'absolute' refer to in the context of the passage?
options: Something that is unchanging and universal.
A measurement of time without any variables.
The speed of light as a constant.
A principle that is often challenged.
questions.explain: 在文中，'absolute' 指的是不變且普遍的概念，這與相對論的觀點形成對比。

daily.passage: Attention students! The campus library will be closed for maintenance this Saturday. Please plan to complete your studies before then. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.

questions.q: When will the campus library be closed?
options: This Saturday.
Next Monday.
Today.
Tomorrow.
questions.explain: 根據公告，校園圖書館將在本週六關閉。

questions.q: Why will the library be closed?
options: For a holiday.
For maintenance.
For renovations.
For staff training.
questions.explain: 圖書館將因為維護工作而關閉。
